name: Shrink Font
what_it_does: Decreases the font size of the selection to the previous step.
behavior: Direct action: Decreases the font size of the selection to the previous step. Applied immediately to the selection's font size; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as a large 'A' beside a small 'A' with a down arrow (Shrink Font).
